body:
This PR updates the Julia 1.13 references that #2214 missed. #2212 had them, but they did not carry over.

Changes
- `downgrade.yml` tests Julia 1.10 and 1.13
- `test/mpi_tests/local_checks.sh` loads `climacommon/2026_10_30-1.13.3`, the `central` module
- `experiments/AMIP/README.md`, `experiments/CMIP/README.md`, and `docs/clima_coupler_specific.md` name Julia 1.13 instead of 1.11

The Derecho calibration pipeline and the `param_sweep` README still load `climacommon/2025_02_25`. I left them out since Derecho still needs a 1.13 module.

This PR is LLM generated.
title: Finish the Julia 1.13 move

Some small improvements in the prescribed sea ice model: Use a temperature-dependent albedo, change the surface melting temperature to 0C, and use different thickness in NH and SH. Addresses part of #2218.

Note: I didn't run amip due to the current instability, but I'm pretty confident that the physics is more realistic. I'll test in amip later.
